denied.title: Location access denied
denied.description: To capture the sensor location automatically, the app needs access to your GPS location. Allow access in your browser settings and try again.

unsupported.title: Location not available
unsupported.description: Your browser or device does not support the Geolocation API in this context. Make sure you are using the app over HTTPS.

error.title: Location could not be determined
error.description: An error occurred while accessing your position. Check that GPS is enabled and that you are outdoors.

denied.description: To scan QR codes, the app needs access to your camera. Allow access in your browser settings and try again.

unsupported.title: Camera not available
unsupported.description: Your browser or device does not support camera access in this context. Make sure you are using the app over HTTPS.

error.title: Camera could not be started
error.description: An error occurred while accessing the camera. Check whether another application is already using the camera.

install.descriptionIos: Tap the share icon in Safari and choose "Add to Home Screen". This starts the scanner directly in full screen without the address bar.
install.descriptionAndroid: Install the app on your device. The scanner starts faster and runs full screen without the browser bar.
